entities.name: Haudenosaunee Great Law of Peace
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The constitution of the Iroquois Confederacy (Haudenosaunee), possibly codified as early as 1142 CE, establishing a representative council of 50 sachems, consensus decision-making, and women's political power (clan mothers nominated chiefs). The Great Law of Peace — one of the oldest participatory governance systems — influenced American constitutional framers, particularly Benjamin Franklin.
